about: Short lecture snippets labeled with the visual type the content shape calls for. Used by server/scripts/visual-eval.mjs. stubVisual is the reference answer the stub upstream returns; it must pass server validation without a downgrade.

segments.text: To open a TCP connection, the client first sends a SYN packet to the server.
The server replies with SYN-ACK. Then the client sends an ACK, and only after that step can data be sent.

stubVisual.recap: A connection opens with SYN, SYN-ACK, then ACK before data flows.

segments.text: In triage, first check whether the patient is breathing. If not, open the airway immediately.
If they are breathing, check the pulse next; a weak pulse means they go to the urgent queue, otherwise to standard care.

stubVisual.recap: Check breathing, then pulse, to route the patient.

segments.text: The citric acid cycle starts when acetyl CoA joins oxaloacetate to form citrate.
Citrate is converted to isocitrate, then alpha-ketoglutarate, then succinate, and finally oxaloacetate is regenerated so the cycle runs again.

stubVisual.recap: Oxaloacetate is regenerated so the cycle repeats.

segments.text: The business cycle moves from expansion to a peak, where growth tops out.
Then comes a contraction, then a trough, and from the trough the economy recovers into expansion again, over and over.

stubVisual.recap: Economies repeat expansion, peak, contraction, and trough.

segments.text: In 1954, Brown v. Board of Education ruled school segregation unconstitutional.
The Montgomery bus boycott began in 1955, the Civil Rights Act passed in 1964, and the Voting Rights Act followed in 1965.

stubVisual.recap: Key rulings and laws from 1954 to 1965.

segments.text: ENIAC was finished in 1945. The transistor was invented at Bell Labs in 1947.
The integrated circuit arrived in 1958, and the first microprocessor, the Intel 4004, shipped in 1971.

stubVisual.recap: From ENIAC to the microprocessor in 26 years.

segments.text: Rocks fall into three main categories: igneous, sedimentary, and metamorphic.
Igneous rocks split into intrusive ones like granite and extrusive ones like basalt. Sedimentary includes sandstone and limestone.

stubVisual.recap: Rocks are igneous, sedimentary, or metamorphic, with subtypes.

segments.text: The federal government has three branches: legislative, executive, and judicial.
The legislative branch is made up of two parts, the Senate and the House of Representatives.

stubVisual.recap: Three branches; Congress has two chambers.

segments.text: Let's compare mitosis and meiosis. Mitosis produces two daughter cells; meiosis produces four.
Mitosis daughter cells are genetically identical and diploid, while meiosis cells are genetically different and haploid.

stubVisual.recap: Mitosis makes two identical diploid cells; meiosis makes four varied haploid cells.

segments.text: TCP and UDP differ in a few ways. TCP is connection-oriented and guarantees delivery.
UDP is connectionless and makes no delivery guarantee, but it has lower overhead, so it suits streaming. TCP has higher overhead.

stubVisual.recap: TCP trades overhead for reliability; UDP is light but unreliable.

segments.text: DNA and RNA overlap in some features. Both have a sugar-phosphate backbone and both use adenine, guanine, and cytosine.
Only DNA uses thymine and deoxyribose and is double stranded. Only RNA uses uracil and ribose and is usually single stranded.

stubVisual.recap: DNA and RNA share a backbone and three bases but differ in sugar, one base, and strands.

segments.text: Think of the overlap between renewable sources and low-carbon sources. Solar and wind are in both sets.
Nuclear is low carbon but not renewable. Burning wood biomass counts as renewable but is not low carbon at the smokestack.

stubVisual.recap: Solar and wind are both; nuclear is only low carbon; biomass only renewable.

segments.text: Course enrollment has grown fast. We had 120 students in 2022 and 180 in 2023.
This year we're at 260 students, more than double 2022.

stubVisual.recap: Enrollment grew from 120 in 2022 to 260 this year.

segments.text: Here's last year's electricity mix: natural gas supplied 43 percent and nuclear 18 percent.
Coal was down to 16 percent, wind 10 percent, and solar about 4 percent.
Price, supply, and demand are all tangled together. Higher prices discourage demand but encourage suppliers.
Consumer income shifts demand, and production costs shift supply, and both of those feed back into price.

stubVisual.recap: Price, supply, and demand influence each other.

segments.text: Inside the computer, the CPU connects to main memory over the memory bus.
The GPU and the SSD both attach to the CPU through PCIe lanes, and the network card hangs off the chipset.

stubVisual.recap: The CPU links memory, GPU, and storage; the NIC hangs off the chipset.

segments.text: Quick reminder before we start: the midterm is next Thursday in this room.
It covers chapters one through five, and you can bring one page of handwritten notes.

stubVisual.recap: Midterm next Thursday here, chapters 1–5, one handwritten page allowed.
